source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 — Listed Building polygons

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1239561 (Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter). Historic England's official NHLE metadata states that listed-building polygons are published for buildings listed or substantively amended since 4 April 2011, and the official list entry was amended on 19 July 2016 with explicit villa building-type evidence; however, the selected layer-3 GeoJSON response could not be retrieved, so no polygon coordinates were read and no individual building record was accepted.
